text.p: 360 Communications Co said Thursday it launched a program under which shareholders owning fewer than 100 shares of common stock can purchase additional shares or sell their eligible shares.

The voluntary program allows the shareholders to sell or purchase at market-based prices. A processing fee of $0.70 a share will be charged, the company said. Shareholder Communications Corp, a specialist in oddlot programs, will administer and manage the programs.
The company said many of its shareowners received fewer than 100 shares in the company's spinoff from Sprint Corp in March 1996.
360 Communications provides wireless and data services.
